description: Author-only, platform-custodial wallets: return a closed, unawarded prize pool to its frozen on-chain author (API key required). Opens only after closes_at; self-custody authors are pointed at the on-chain reclaim(). A repeat after success signs nothing. Arg: slug. Returns the benchmark detail plus a reclaim block (status, reclaim_tx, failure, failure_code). REST twin: POST /api/v1/benchmarks/{slug}/prize/reclaim.

inputSchema.description: A benchmark slug that defaults to the routed benchmark on its rail.

slug.description: Benchmark slug from benchmarks_list or benchmarks_search. Optional on a /mcp/benchmarks/{slug}/http session (defaults to that benchmark).
slug.title: Slug

inputSchema.title: BenchmarkRailSlugArgs
